_comment: Single source of the anti-sleep auto-clicker defaults (Ctrl+M, sg_actions.activity_simulation), read by the three drivers and the library window. threshold is the least normalised cross-correlation of a match (0 to 1), per image unless the library overrides it. scales are the power-of-two factors a library image is also tried at, for a button captured on a 1x screen and matched on a 2x one or the reverse. The coarse_* keys bound the coarse-to-fine search (_shared/shortcuts/engine/auto_click_matcher.lua). allowed_apps lists, per OS, the foreground apps the auto-clicker may click in: bundle ids on macOS, executable names on Windows, WM classes on Linux. The tick and the cooldown are durations: they live in the timings registry ([keep_awake] auto_click_tick_ms and auto_click_cooldown_ms).
